retrievalProfile.description: A centered portrait immersed in golden-hour light featuring high-contrast sparkler-effect typography in the foreground.
triggerTerms: golden hour portrait with sparkler text
excludeWhen: dark or moody themes are required

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered medium-shot portrait of a woman in a field of tall grass, characterized by intense backlighting, golden lens flares, and glowing bokeh. The composition is anchored by a large, luminous title at the bottom rendered as if written with sparklers.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a bright, overexposed sky
Foreground grass blurred to create depth and frame the subject
Warm golden tones throughout the image contrasting with dark clothing
Sparkler typography overlapping the lower third of the subject
coreInvariants: High-key golden hour lighting with visible lens flares
Sparkler-effect light painting for the primary title
Wide-tracked sans-serif secondary text at the top

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally aligned, medium shot from the waist up, occupying the middle vertical third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing sparkler text at the bottom serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright sparkler text, moves up to the subject's face, and then to the wide-spaced text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper corners are filled with bright, blown-out light and bokeh, creating an airy feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Golden yellow and warm amber (lighting and grass)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep brown and black (subject's clothing and eyes)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white (hottest points of the sparkler text and sun)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (brightness) with warm, high-saturation yellows and oranges.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm spectrum and neutrals

letterConstructionRules: Primary text must appear as if drawn with a handheld sparkler
Irregular, jittery strokes with radiating light particles
Secondary text must be extremely wide-tracked and thin
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the primary title have glowing 'hot spots' at stroke intersections
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of organic, textured light-painting with clean, minimalist geometric sans-serif.

avoid: Standard handwriting fonts without light effects

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, modern feel of the top metadata text.
The primary title requires a procedural or hand-drawn light effect rather than a standard font.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a centered portrait of a woman in a field of tall dry grass during golden hour. Use heavy backlighting to create a halo effect around her hair and shoulders. Include prominent golden lens flares and soft bokeh in the foreground and background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the primary title in the lower third using a white and yellow sparkler light-painting effect. Add the secondary name text at the very top in a thin, dark brown sans-serif with extreme letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the sparkler text glowing and textured?
Is the top text spaced widely across the width?
Is the lighting warm and overexposed in the background?

adjustableVariables: Amount of tracking in the top text
mustRedesign: Do not use standard solid fonts for the main title; it must be light-painted.
postGenerationChecks: Check that the sparkler text overlaps the grass naturally.
Ensure the top text is perfectly centered and legible despite the wide tracking.
Verify that the subject's face remains the focal point despite the bright effects.
Confirm the color palette is strictly warm (golds, ambers, browns).
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered Portrait + Golden Hour Backlighting + Sparkler Light-Painting Title + Wide-Tracked Sans-Serif Header
